subject: Next steps & mutual action playbook — Pharos Energy discovery
messages:
From: rohan_mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.com>
To: Lina Zhao <lina.zhao@pharos-energy.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 13:12:00 -0800
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed mutual action playbook

Hi Lina —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap to make sure we’re aligned and to propose a short mutual action playbook so we can move from discovery -> pilot quickly. I’ve listed pain points, goals, and suggested owners/dates below. Please edit anything I’ve mis-stated.

Pain points you shared:
- Spiky inference cost with burst workloads (esp. ad-hoc analytics) — forecasted <cost reduction target> is needed.
- Frequent 95th-tail latency spikes for our in-house fine-tuned models (affects user-facing workflows).
- Strict data residency and audit requirements for model inputs; must be able to run inside VPC/on-prem.
- Procurement wants a clear procurement checklist (SOC2, data residency, KMS).

Goals you mentioned:
- Reduce inference cost per call by ~2.5–3x for common batch patterns.
- Achieve steady-state p95 latency <120ms at 512 tokens for the customer-facing path.
- Pilot in a dedicated VPC environment and demonstrate audit logs and KMS integration.
- Decision by Jan 28, 2027 (targeting pilot start in early Feb).

Proposed mutual action playbook (high level):
1) Scope & success metrics (Owner: Lina / Pharos) — Complete by 2026-12-15
   - Define 3 representative workloads & success criteria (cost reduction %, p95 target).
2) Technical prep & security checklist (Owner: Manish / Pharos + Grace / Redwood) — Docs ready by 2026-12-22
   - Provide SOC2 report, KMS cipher support matrix, network diagrams.
3) Pilot delivery (Owner: Redwood: Grace; Pharos: Lina) — Pilot window 2027-02-07 to 2027-03-07
   - Dedicated VPC, 2 model variants (full-precision & quantized), tracing hooks.
4) Evaluation & decision (Owner: Executive sponsor Samir / Pharos + Vivek / Redwood) — Decision by 2027-01-28 (pre-pilot gating) and final by 2027-03-15

I attached a one-sheet MAP (MAP_Pharos-v1.xlsx) that turns the above into dates and owners. Also attached a short SLA summary for procurement.

Next steps I suggest from Redwood:
- Grace will draft the technical onboarding checklist and a pilot runbook by 2026-12-10.
- I’ll schedule a 30-minute procurement sync between Manish and our Security & Compliance lead (cc’d after we confirm availability).

Would you and Manish be able to confirm the Scope & success metrics item by next Wednesday (12/15)? If that works I’ll lock calendar slots for the technical prep session.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Best,
Rohan Mehta
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rohan.mehta@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_Pharos-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 28KB) ; Redwood-SLA-summary.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Lina Zhao <lina.zhao@pharos-energy.com>

Cc: Manish Patel <manish.patel@pharos-energy.com>, Samir Rao <samir.rao@pharos-energy.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 08:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed mutual action playbook

Thanks Rohan — this looks right and helpful. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Scope & representative workloads — we’ll confirm three workloads by 2026-12-14 (one is customer-chat, one is predictions for energy trading, one is internal analytics batch scoring). The cost target can be worked into each workload; our procurement will want a line-item breakdown.

2) Security checklist — procurement expects SOC2 Type II and an auditor contact; they also require HSM-backed KMS or bring-your-own-key options.

3) Timeline — the dates look reasonable; we’d like a week buffer before the pilot (if you can start pilot kickoff the week of 2027-02-07 that’s ideal).

I’m looping in Manish and Samir for availability on a procurement sync — Manish, can you confirm if 2026-12-16 or 2026-12-17 at 10am PT works?

Lina
Sr. Product Manager, AI Platform
Pharos Energy
